gloss: to turn pale; to go white

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {青|あお}ざめていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to turn pale; to go white; to blanch
definitions.explanation: To lose color in the face due to fear, shock, illness, or extreme emotion. The face takes on a pale, bloodless appearance. Almost always describes a visible physical reaction to something alarming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{青|あお}ざめた。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青|あお}ざめた。
examples.english: Her face went pale when she heard the news of the accident.

examples.japanese: {青|あお}ざめた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{悟|さと}った→悟る：12601_satoru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing him come out of the hospital with a pale face, I realized something had happened.

notes:
USAGE:
{青|あお}ざめる is most often used with ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face) as the subject, or with the person as the subject (implying their face). The past participle {青|あお}ざめた is frequently used as a modifier: {青|あお}ざめた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (a pale face).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青|あお}ざめる (one's face turns pale)
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{青|あお}ざめる (to turn pale with fear)
- {青|あお}ざめた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (a pale/ashen face)
- {青|あお}ざめた⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (a pale expression)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {青|あお}ざめる: to turn pale (face loses color; fear/shock)
- ⟦{青白|あおじろ}い→青白い：14652_aojiroi⟧: pale, pallid (adjective describing complexion)
- {血|ち}の{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: the blood drains from one's face (stronger expression)
